description.zh: 仅支持传入备份策略为单库备份的备份集ID。单次最多传入100个备份集ID，多个值之间用半角逗号（,）隔开。可调用DescribeBackups获取。
description.en: You can specify only the ID of a backup file whose backup policy is Single-database Backup. You can specify the IDs of up to 100 backup files at a time. Separate the IDs with commas (,). You can call the DescribeBackups operation to query the IDs of data backup files.

description.zh: 删除该时间点之前的备份文件。格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。
description.en: The time before which the backup files you want to delete are generated. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.
The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID.
The region ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstanceAttribute operation to query the region ID.

descriptions.zh:
### 适用引擎
RDS SQL Server



> **新用户不支持使用该接口**，您可以通过其他方案[减少或节省备份费用](~~95718~~)。此前已加白用户仍可正常使用，删除前请确认备份集可用性，一旦删除不支持再找回。
descriptions.en:
### [](#)Supported database engine

SQL Server

>  **This operation is not supported for new users. **Select other methods to [reduce or save backup costs](~~95718~~). Users who are added to the whitelist can still use the backup file. Check the availability of the backup file before you delete it. After the backup file is deleted, you cannot retrieve it.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun rds delete-backup-file --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-id rm-bp6wjk50000 --backup-id 293040000 --db-name testdb --backup-time 2024-06-11T16:00:00Z --region cn-hangzhou
